product_metadata.title: JMTGNSEP Curtain light LED Fairy String Light 8 Modes Control Decoration for Bedroom Window Christmas Wedding Party Home Garden Outdoor Indoor,USB Operated. CURTAIN is NOT included.
features: 8 Twinkle modes: The 8 Twinkle modes can be realized by both remote controller and the blue button in the USB port. the 8 Light Modes including: Combination, in waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on.
Perfect for indoor and outdoor decorations: Widely used in various occasions and places, such as bedroom, parties, windows Christmas, Valentine’s Day, hotel, commercial buildings and so on.
Specification: 7.8Ft x 5.9Ft ( 8 strings and 18 LED lights per string). IP64 Waterproof, USB plug-in(USB adaptor not included).

Easy to install: Our fairy string curtains lights no assembly required, simple connect USB connector/laptop/notebook and play. They have hooks on the top of each string, hang the lights before you unravel the strings so they won't get tangled. DO NOT take the twist ties off before you hang them up.
This Light Will Make Your Life Lovely. NOTE: ONLY STRING LIGHTS, NOT COME WITH A CURTAIN, MAINLY USED FOR CURTAIN DECORATION.
